notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Inspector Megure, Takagi) omitted by convention. case_type: murder. The old low-fidelity case file already had the correct culprit (Satoko Takehara) and the correct core clue (matching bloodstain on her neck vs. the victim's neck/jacket), so no culprit/clue reversal correction was needed here -- this rebuild's changes are additive: it separates the single vague 'rigging' object into its real distinct physical parts (shotgun, fishing line, wooden drum, hawk's lure, Genichi's hunting jacket), replaces the two generic 'event' nodes with direct typed edges (kills, drags_body_of, fakes_time_of_death_of, stages_alibi_using), adds the farmer Ishima and falconer Akashiba as fully-fledged witness/suspect persons with was_at coverage, adds the unnamed café-buyer backstory figure whose sale negotiation supplies Satoko's motive, and adds two additional relational clues (the hawk's fishing-line ankle injury; the no-echo/absence-during-puffed-rice timing contradiction) beyond the single bloodstain clue the old file recorded.

clues.desc: Bloodstain comparison: the red stain on Satoko's neck matches the bloodstain in the same spot on Genichi's neck and on his hunting jacket -- proves she wore his jacket to impersonate him.

Hawk's freshly bandaged ankle injury, which Akashiba says could come from something like fishing line, tips Conan off that a fishing-line rig -- not the hawk attacking Genichi -- fired the fatal-looking shot.

Timing contradiction: Conan's shout toward the distant figure he took for Genichi during the puffed-rice demonstration got no echoing reply, and Satoko was the one person unaccounted for at that exact moment -- proving the figure was not Genichi and that she had the opportunity to kill him then.
